notes: Real per-resident simulation; off mode, no external injections. Daily SQLite original-event archive, validated compacted checkpoints and causal references. 1,000 residents for 60 days in three seeds; 3,000 for 30 days in two seeds. Local wall times are not a production SLA. Each 60-day run includes 3 extra continuity-check ticks; each 30-day run includes 2. Extra tick counts describe the existing day-1/every-30-days continuation checks.
